text:
maggie: starting a small canary for q4v3-int4 on staging, 5% traffic to variant B. quick heads-up: long-doc MRR looks slightly worse than baseline on slice 'legal-templates'
jamal: noted. any signal from the longctx KV warmup?
ryan: initial KV hit-rate is fine, but we see a non-monotonic drop in concordance after ~1200 tokens for some prompts. attaching a snippet:
ryan: ```
slice: legal-templates
metric: concordance
baseline: 0.912
variantB: 0.887 at seqlen>1200
delta: -0.025
```
sophia: ouch. is that an artifact of quantized attention kernels or a model diff?
maggie: hypothesis: fused-attn quant path in int4 has different chunking, so KV prefixes with long repeated tokens can misalign topk scoring. we also saw token-softmax variance increase on the same samples.
anya: what's our canary gate threshold again for MRR and KL? I recall we use a composite gate: MRR delta > -0.01 OR KL divergence > 0.06 triggers cooldown.
jamal: correct, but we also have a hysteresis window: if drift happens transiently for one window (5m) we don't auto-rollback; needs sustained drop for 30m OR a human ack.
ryan: current probe shows sustained drop for the last 18m, not 30. ops: deploy-bot, pause the ramp to 5% -> hold at 1% while we investigate :eyes:
deploy-bot: @maggie ramp paused. Variant B traffic set to 1%. Audit id: canary-1716054321.
sophia: can we run a targeted A/B eval on the failing 400-sample legal-templates holdout (offline)? request: run eval@offline with seed=42, compare top-k concordance, token-entropy, and hallucination-score.
maggie: kicking off offline eval now. if offline confirms, plan: rollback B to previous quant-profile (nf4-int4-v2) OR apply KV-warmup tweak (increase warmup factor to 3). Which do we prefer as quick rollback?
anya: quick rollback to nf4-int4-v2 is safest for production. KV warmup tweak is lower-risk but requires another canary to validate.
jamal: also propose adding a non-monotonicity detector to the canary watcher: detect sign flips in metric slices by seqlen bucket. if metric flips sign across adjacent buckets with amplitude > 0.02 -> alert and auto-hold.
ryan: agreed. logs show token-entropy delta spikes at the same token boundary. I'll add a lightweight rule in the watcher config: "nonmonotonic_flip_threshold": "0.02" and "sustain_minutes": "10" for now.
sophia: offline eval finished: concordance delta = -0.027, KL(token) = 0.075, hallucination-score +0.9 (worse).
maggie: that crosses our emergency criterion (KL>0.06 AND MRR drop >0.015). I'm going to request rollback to nf4-int4-v2. Jamal / Ops, please execute.
jamal: rolling back variant B -> nf4-int4-v2 on canary. will monitor then.
deploy-bot: rollback completed for audit id canary-1716054321 at 1716054350. New variant B= nf4-int4-v2, traffic=5%.
anya: postmortem action items: 1) add non-monotonicity detector to canary watcher 2) add seqlen-sliced shadow compare for long-doc slices 3) produce a short runbook entry about KV warmup heuristics & quant path interactions 4) run a micro-benchmark of fused-attn vs reference on seqlen>1024.
ryan: I'll take 1 and 4. sophia takes 2, maggie will draft 3.
maggie: thanks. small win — canary prevented a noisy cutover. we'll reconvene after the micro-bench. :thumbsup:
